summary: The workshop is over and nobody sets your days any more. You write a small weekly rhythm, a monthly review and a three-month plan with a goal you can check; you turn the README's list of what you never ran into a backlog with a counter that should shrink; and you learn the rule that decides when an item counts as run. Run for real: a small counter on the capstone README. The plan itself is a template.
goal: Closing lesson: a three-month plan and a rhythm you can keep.

items.text: Add scripts/not_run.py to your repository and run it, with a 'What has not been run' section in your README
Pick the first item you will run for real and write down what you think will break
Write the cheapest way to fool yourself about an item, then read the four-point rule and see what it skips
Write your three months: a goal you can check, the weekly slots with times in your calendar, one item per month
Put the first monthly review (the first Sunday of next month) in your calendar
Play the Next Three Months game to the end and see your score
